scientific_integrity: A self-contained all-integer-m proof is supplied; finite computation is corroborative and not a replacement for proof. Same-model mathematical review only, with no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact intrinsic Frobenius inball and all its centers for normalized nonsymmetric 2-by-m Monge polytopes, m>=3. Does not cover 2-by-2 (previous square result), arbitrary p-by-q, ellipsoids or other metrics. Full 2026 motivating manuscript was not fully reinspected; priority is not externally certified.
title: The parity-dependent incenter locus of nonsquare two-row Monge polytopes
